title: Add benchmark-lab performance suites, profiling baselines and reporting pipeline v117
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Adds v117 of benchmark lab performance suites, new profiling baselines for multi-variant workloads, and a reporting pipeline to ingest results into telemetry. Includes docs and CI pipeline updates.
description: Motivation: the benchmark lab needs a new iteration of performance suites to cover mixed and multi-variant workloads (latency and memory profiling), refreshed profiling baselines for recent model/kernel changes, and a robust reporting pipeline so CI job outputs are stored and visualized in the telemetry stack. This PR: 1) Adds v117 performance suites (mixed, long-context, chat-like loads) and representative workload runners for NVidia and AMD nodes; 2) Adds profiling-baseline manifests and golden traces for the kernels impacted by the attention fusion changes; 3) Implements a reporting pipeline (ci/pipelines/benchmark-reporting.yaml) that converts test artifacts into ndjson and uploads to telemetry; 4) Updates benchmark-lab docs and onboarding; 5) Adds health checks and retry logic to runners. Testing: unit + integration + perf runs were executed in staging. Rollout: merged to main; reporting pipeline will be enabled behind feature flag and toggled for nightly jobs. Checklist: - [x] Add workload runners and runners templates - [x] Add profiling baseline manifests and golden traces - [x] Add reporting CI pipeline and uploader - [x] Update docs and quickstarts - [x] Run end-to-end on staging and validate telemetry ingestion
commits: feat(benchmark-lab): add mixed and multi-variant workload runners (runner templates and example configs)

docs(benchmark-lab): document new suites and onboarding steps
fix(runners): add retry/backoff on artifact upload and health-check improvements
changed_file_snippets: ci/pipelines/benchmark-reporting.yaml: added job 'benchmark-report' that runs suites, converts artifacts to ndjson and uploads to telemetry

review_comments: Connor Lee: Nice work documenting the runner templates. A couple of nits: can we reduce the default batch size in the mixed_runner example to avoid OOMs on 16GB GPUs?
Priya Shah (author): Good catch — lowered default batch_size to 8 and added note to README. Pushed fix in commit 3.
Miguel Ortega: CI pipeline looks good. One request: expose the telemetry upload endpoint via env var and fail gracefully if not set.
Priya Shah (author): Done — uploader now reads TELEMETRY_UPLOAD_URL and skips upload when unset (tests updated).
Jing Wu: Approving after the minor lint errors are fixed in the last commit.
CI Bot: integration-tests failed on first run (flake in test_end_to_end.py). Reran and passed.
merge_outcome: Merged to main via squash on 2025-11-25 after approvals from reviewers. The reporting pipeline is feature-flagged and will be enabled for nightly jobs first.
